game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: AthienLily
quote: I'm absolutely loving the game. Without a doubt, it has the best graphics we've seen in this console generation. Beyond the visuals, I personally really appreciate the focus on Jason and Lucia's romantic relationship. Complaining about that aspect feels like something only immature players, particularly kids or teenagers, would do.What makes the experience even more impressive, though, is how alive everything feels. The character's interactions with the world, the environmental details, the dialogue, and the characters themselves all contribute to an incredibly immersive experience. The world doesn't feel static or artificial; it feels genuinely alive, reactive, and full of **** me, GTA VI is a solid 10/10. Rockstar seems to have delivered something truly special.

author: AthienLily
quote: It’s just a kart game—there isn’t much room to innovate here, just stick to the formula that already works. It has plenty of characters and fun tracks, although I think the game launched with too few track options and not enough variety. I don’t believe the open-world mode is necessary or useful; they could have invested in making more maps instead of that mode.That said, it’s still a great game. I have a lot of fun playing it, and without a doubt it’s the game I’ve played the most on the Switch 2.

author: AthienLily
quote: It’s a great tennis party game. The game is very consistent, and I wouldn’t say its focus is the story mode—because, let’s be honest, what do you expect from the story of a sports game? It offers different play styles; each racket and racket combination—yours and your opponent’s—completely changes your strategy, along with the characters’ individual stats and powers. It has high replayability, is extremely fun for co-op, and features a great online mode that really supports your learning **** for the story mode, I imagined it would be a tutorial—which isn’t a problem. If I want to play a tennis game, I want to play tennis, not watch a live action.

author: AthienLily
quote: One of the greatest games of 2025. Not just because of its impeccable technical quality—being considered the first true next-gen game—but also because its story and the depth of its characters make Death Stranding 2 a cinematic masterpiece in the form ****. In a year filled with incredible releases (with the exception of Donkey Kong), Death Stranding 2 still manages to stand out as revolutionary.

author: AthienLily
quote: The best two-player experience I’ve had this year — without a doubt, it’s one of the most creative and nostalgic games to hit the market. Josef Fares does an incredible job of building rich and unique universes that transport you to those childhood fantasy films, while also creating games that make you truly connect with the person playing next to you.

author: AthienLily
quote: I can’t deny it—Clair Obscur is easily the most complete and unique game I’ve ever played. The reasons it made it to my number one spot are simple: a perfect soundtrack, well-designed parry mechanics that make the combat more engaging, and a top-tier story—a narrative about grief, pain, and fighting against our own thoughts. By the way, the characters feel so alive, and their dialogues are perfectly written. You can clearly see the effort the voice actors put into their performances through every line. 10/10 -My top 1 game right now.
